name: @projexlight/identity-projector
summary: Projector service for sdk-identity-resolver — consumes identity-events from sdk-persona / sdk-identity / sdk-crm and materializes the canonical persona projection so resolveIdentityContext returns sub-millisecond. Background workers backfill on attach + reproject on schema change.

events.name: identity-projector.projection.refreshed.v1
events.description: Projection rebuilt for a (tenant, persona) tuple.

hooks.name: startProjector
hooks.description: Background worker — pulls identity events from inbox topic + writes projection rows.

hooks.name: backfillTenant
hooks.description: One-shot backfill for a tenant whose projection is stale or missing.

scenarios.title: Start background projector
scenarios.when_to_use: Process startup. Subscribes to identity events; writes the canonical projection.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startProjector } from '@projexlight/identity-projector';
await startProjector({ batch_size: 100, interval_ms: 5000 });

scenarios.title: Backfill projection on tenant attach
scenarios.when_to_use: New tenant onboarded; backfill walks all identity events for the tenant + materializes the projection from scratch.
scenarios.example_code:
import { backfillTenant } from '@projexlight/identity-projector';
await backfillTenant({ tenant_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Projection populated; emits .backfill.completed.v1 with row counts.

scenarios.title: Schema change → reproject affected tenants
scenarios.when_to_use: Projection-row schema added; ops reprojects affected tenants over a few hours.
scenarios.example_code: for (const t of await listTenants()) await backfillTenant({ tenant_id: t.id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: All projections rebuilt with new schema. No application downtime — old + new schema rows coexist via additive migration.

scenarios.title: Lag alarm if projector falls behind
scenarios.when_to_use: Background — if inbox depth > threshold for > 5 min, page on-call.
scenarios.example_code: // monitored via consumer-group lag metric; alarm wired to sdk-notification.
scenarios.expected_outcome: On-call paged. Operator scales the projector worker pool.

scenarios.title: Graceful drain ensures no event loss
scenarios.when_to_use: Rolling deploy; drainAndShutdown commits the current batch + exits cleanly so the next pod picks up at the right offset.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Zero event loss. Consumer-group offset advances correctly.

compliance_posture.notes: Projector is fully derivable from the audit log; backfill replays from the source events. No persistent state lost on container restart.
